_doc: WorkerGrid config. WorkerGrid is a producer-agnostic execution plane; it consumes a producer's work API. For Product Forge, set pf_api_url to the PF API base. Token is read from the API_TOKEN env var (or WORKERGRID_TOKEN).

store._doc: Coordination-store backend (Stage 3b). driver: sqlite (default, single-node; dsn defaults to <state_dir>/workergrid.db) | postgres (multi-node; dsn REQUIRED, e.g. postgres://user:pass@host:5432/db). Env overrides: WORKERGRID_STORE_DRIVER, WORKERGRID_STORE_DSN.

agent._doc: Stage 3c worker agent (/wg agent). repo_root = the git repo to execute work in (required). runtimes.<name>.command is a shell command template; placeholders {item_id} {title} {worktree} {branch} {base_ref} are substituted (shell-quoted) and exported as WG_* env vars. success_status = the PF status written on an exit-0 run (default verifying, keeps gates in the human path).

command.command: opencode run --model opencode/deepseek-v4.1-flash --auto "You are a Product Forge worker in a git worktree. Follow workergrid/instructions.md and product-forge/AGENTS.md. Read .wg/assignment.json and the WG_* env vars for the assigned item (objective, acceptance criteria, scope, affected files, pidl_context, execution_policy). Implement the item end-to-end on the current branch, wire and exercise it, run lint and precheck, and commit. Do NOT push, open a PR, or merge - PF's delivery lane owns push/PR/merge. Then exit."
